newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Minoan Lines in syndicated 125mln ecu loan.
newsitem.headline: Greek Minoan Lines in syndicated 125mln ecu loan.

text.p: Passenger shipper Minoan Lines signed a 125 million ecu syndicated loan for the financing of its two new high-speed ferries -- Ikarus and Pasiphae, it said in a statement.
Citibank Shipping was the arranger and manager of the syndicated loan, Minoan Lines said.
The signing took place on the company's King Minos vessel.

The syndicate includes Bayerishe Vereinsbank, Citibank-Channel Islands, ABN AMRO, Christiania Bank Og Kreditkasse, Landesbank Schleswig Holstein Girozentrale LSHG.D, Bank of Nova Scotia, National Bank of Greece and ETBA.
Minoan's two new high-speed ferries will cost $210 million and join its fleet of six ships now covering the Italy-Greece route. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
